title: hieracium doronicifolium subsp. neurophyllum
intro: Hieracium doronicifolium subsp. neurophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the management of various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed include anti-oxidant, anti-hemorrhagic, and anti-inflammatory effects, which can contribute to its potential use in treating conditions such as eczema and acne. The bioactive constituents of Hawkweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
